bio: Sasha Peck First-Year Social Committee Oak Yard Hi! My name is Sasha Peck. I’m a first-year living in Thayer! I’m from Ridgefield, Connecticut and graduated from Wooster School in Danbury, CT. I love event planning, so I am so excited to be a part of this year’s First Year Social Committee. But most importantly, I love how FYSC values inclusivity and community. I cannot wait to get to know more of the Class of 2026 this year and to help plan activities for all of us to take part in!
